title_en: Call for 2027 Kwanjeong Lee Jong-hwan Educational Foundation New Undergraduate Scholars
summary: Undergraduate students who will enter their 5th semester in Spring 2027 with a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 or higher may seek a university recommendation for the 2027 Kwanjeong Lee Jong-hwan Educational Foundation undergraduate scholarship. The department recommendation form (Attachment 4) and all other documents must be submitted by email by Friday, 13 November 2026; the email address is given in the original notice. Final recommendees will be notified to departments on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 15:00.
applies_to: Optional: undergraduate students who will enter their 5th semester in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) and have a cumulative grade point average of 3.8/4.3 or higher. Further eligibility limits, such as age, are set out in the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2). Each department may recommend at most 2 students, and the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 students in total.

dates.what: Deadline to submit the department recommendation form (Attachment 4) and all documents by email
Notification of final recommendees to departments
Semester in which applicants must be entering their 5th semester

conditions: Applicants must be entering their 5th semester in Spring 2027 and have a cumulative GPA of at least 3.8/4.3.
Other eligibility limits, including an age limit, are in the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2), which must be checked.
Each department may recommend at most 2 students; the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10.
Applicants may choose either Type A or Type B.

Type A (Kwanjeong Academic Excellence Scholarship) pays 6,000,000 KRW per semester for up to 4 semesters, covering tuition and a study stipend, and cannot be combined with any other scholarship, including national and university scholarships.
Type B (Kwanjeong Study Encouragement Scholarship) pays up to 4,000,000 KRW per semester for up to 4 semesters as a study stipend and may be combined with national and university scholarships.
Type B cannot be combined with scholarships from other private foundations.
For Type B, the amount will be adjusted if national or university scholarships already cover both tuition and living expenses.
If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be treated as having no recommendee.
If College of Engineering applications exceed 10, recommendees are selected by GPA on a 4.3 scale; ties are broken by GPA percentile and then by the previous semester's grades.
Students who pass the document screening must take part in the expert review (2nd stage) and the interview (3rd stage).
steps: Read the foundation's 2027 selection plan (Attachment 2-1) and the scholarship regulations (Attachment 2-2) to confirm eligibility, including the age limit.
Choose Type A or Type B.

Prepare the department recommendation form (Attachment 4) and all other required documents; the attachments also include a recommendation list file (Attachment 3, .xlsx) and a personal information consent form (.hwp).
Submit all documents by email by Friday, 13 November 2026; the email address is given in the original notice.
Await the notification of final recommendees to departments on Wednesday, 18 November 2026 at 15:00.
If recommended, check your email for the foundation's instructions on online document submission and follow them.
If you pass the document screening, attend the expert review (2nd stage) and the interview (3rd stage) according to the foundation's schedule.
translation:
Call for 2027 Kwanjeong Lee Jong-hwan Educational Foundation New Undergraduate Scholars

The Kwanjeong Lee Jong-hwan Educational Foundation will select new undergraduate scholars for the 2027 academic year as follows.

A. Number of recommendees: up to 2 per department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend up to 10 students.

B. Eligibility: students who will enter their 5th semester in Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) with a cumulative grade point average of 3.8/4.3 or higher.
※ For detailed eligibility, such as the age limit, refer to the scholar selection plan [Attachment 2].

C. Scholarship amount and period ※ Either Type A or Type B may be chosen.

- Kwanjeong Academic Excellence Scholarship (Type A) | Undergraduate | 6,000,000 KRW per semester (up to 4 semesters) | Tuition and study stipend | Cannot be received together with other scholarships (including national and university scholarships).
- Kwanjeong Study Encouragement Scholarship (Type B) | Undergraduate | Up to 4,000,000 KRW per semester (up to 4 semesters) | Study stipend | May be received together with national and university scholarships. ※ Cannot be received together with scholarships from other private foundations. ※ If tuition and living expenses are both supported by national or university scholarships, the scholarship amount will be adjusted.

D. Recommendee selection procedure
1) Deadline for submitting all documents, including the department recommendation form [Attachment 4]: Friday, 13 November 2026 / submit by email (the email address is given in the original notice).
※ If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be deemed that there is no recommendee.
※ If applications exceed the College of Engineering quota (10 students), recommendees will be selected by grade point average on a 4.3 scale; in case of a tie, selection will be by grades (GPA percentile, then previous semester's grades).
2) Notification of final recommendees to departments: Wednesday, 18 November 2026, 15:00.

Notes
1) For details on scholar selection, you must check the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2).
2) The foundation will send university recommendees an email about online document submission; please check it.
3) Students who pass the document screening must take part in the expert review (2nd stage) and interview (3rd stage); recommendees should be informed of the screening schedule.

Attachments (4 files; their contents were not read):
- 2-1. 2027 Domestic University Scholar Selection Plan (PDF, 448 KB)
- 2-2. Regulations on Selection of Domestic University Scholars and Payment of Scholarships (10th amendment) (PDF, 97 KB)
- 3. 2027 Kwanjeong Scholar Recommendation List (Undergraduate) (XLSX, 12 KB)
- Consent to Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (Scholarship and Welfare Division, External Foundations) (HWP, 18 KB)

Note: the notice refers to the department recommendation form as Attachment 4, but no file numbered 4 appears in the attachment list.
